description: Named references, numeric decimal and hex, the Windows-1252 remap of the C1 range, a missing semicolon, and two that are not references at all
notes: – decodes to U+2013 EN DASH rather than U+0096: HTML5 writes the Windows-1252 mis-mapping into the spec because every browser had to implement it. � and � both become U+FFFD. ∉ is U+2209 and not '¬' followed by 'in'. '&amp' without a semicolon still resolves; '&nosuchentity;' and a bare '&' stay literal.
